video_title: KCP to the Sixers: Reuniting with Lebron and Golf Fails | EP54

quotes.speaker: Jordan McGruder
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Philadelphia 76ers roster after adding Paul George
quotes.excerpt: I look at Philly's roster right now, that's just a top-three, top-five. You got Maxey, Embiid, Brown.

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McGruder
text_blocks.text: What you think about LeBron and Philly right now?

text_blocks.speaker: KCP
text_blocks.text: I like the move. I look at Philly's roster right now, that's just a top-three, top-five. You got Maxey, Embiid, Brown. Now you got LeBron.

quotes.speaker: KCP
quotes.summary_phrase: KCP discusses his role as a fourth option on a team
quotes.excerpt: Considering him being a fourth option is still dangerous. He's going to control the floor a little bit.

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McGruder
text_blocks.text: When have we ever seen a team with three MVPs? Basically three MVPs.

text_blocks.speaker: KCP
text_blocks.text: By the first time that I can think of. This is the best what makes it crazy. You got a team full of basically three MVPs on the team. But that's what I was saying, considering him being a fourth option is still dangerous. He's going to control the floor a little bit. He ain't just going to fall back and just be out there. He got a great presence. Like he got the LeBron James, he going to demand the ball or he's going to cause defense to react, whether it's a double team or shifting to him early. So that'll leave, you know, like a Maxey wide open for them pull up threes or spot up threes.

quotes.speaker: KCP
quotes.summary_phrase: KCP on his desire to play meaningful basketball and compete for championships
quotes.excerpt: I just want to get back to playing meaningful basketball, like playing for something, for another championship.

text_blocks.speaker: KCP
text_blocks.text: Meaningful basketball. I just want to get back to playing meaningful basketball, like playing for something, for another championship. I say that that area again, that spotlight, you know, the playoffs. Ain't nothing like them lights, bright, and the competition, the competitiveness, I want it. I still got a lot of years in me that I can still can go.

quotes.speaker: Jordan McGruder
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan McGruder argues KCP should be a starter
quotes.excerpt: I think you should be the one that started, because KCP coming off the bench, a spark.

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan McGruder
text_blocks.text: I think you should be the one that started, because KCP coming off the bench, a spark coming off the bench. I mean, they have, y'all have a bench already. But I'm saying like, that's another, that's another spark and now, you know, with your role, you're, you know, you're that 3-and-D guy and there's a lot of guys that are ball dominant on that, in that starter roster.

text_blocks.speaker: KCP
text_blocks.text: If you're going to go that way, then yeah, I, I, I'm accepting that. But like for me, I got to say, it's not personal. Like I'm going to come in, like to give my team 110%. You know what I'm saying? And you know KCP, I'm going to do that. Each and every night, I'm going to be available. I got a goal, you know what I'm saying? If that's the case, that the young fellas start, I want to be a sixth man.
